recognize_zh: 下半部多顆圓形核偏心、細胞質灰藍並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞聚集，部分核染色質較開放且可見核仁，漿細胞明顯增加，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Numerous plasma cells with round eccentric nuclei and moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof visible in several cells
Some plasma cells show open chromatin with visible nucleoli (atypical/immature forms)
Admixed band neutrophils, myelocytes and small lymphocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells, forming a prominent population among the nucleated cells in this field. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei, moderately abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs, and several display less condensed chromatin with nucleoli. Residual granulocytic precursors and small lymphocytes are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, to be confirmed by plasma cell percentage and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature and polytypic without nucleoli, whereas clonal kappa/lambda restriction and aberrant CD56/CD117 with loss of CD19/CD45 support myeloma.
MGUS has <10% clonal marrow plasma cells without CRAB/SLiM features, so the distinction relies on quantitation and clinical criteria rather than cytology.
LPL shows small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein rather than sheets of plasma cells.
